title: POP MART U.S. lists two distinct Wishes Come True pendant blind-box series
summary: Official POP MART U.S. listings give November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific as the online release date for two separate THE MONSTERS blind-box formats: WHERE WISHES COME TRUE Sachet Pendant Blind Box (USD 19.99 per single random box; PVC/iron and polyester shell) and Wishes Come True Plush Pendant Blind Box (USD 29.99 per single random box; polyester-based plush). Each product also shows a separate Whole Set option whose asking price was not verified. Prices were observed from the product pages on November 16, not inferred from the mainland launch or treated as completed sales. Mainland availability, online fulfillment, stock and whole-set prices were not verified; this is a dated U.S. offer check rather than a new November 16 launch or catalog addition.
